title: Aphelion final curation handoff
content:
Aphelion closed this pass with a quieter and more consistent admin shell. The main curation work was already in place: MySQL-backed card identity records, folder-aware queues, live metadata editing, multi-select rarity/series/attribute filters, direct image URL handling, and a practical one-screen review surface. This final cleanup focused on making the page frame stop getting in the way.

What changed at the handoff:

  • Admin and Options banners: both pages now use the same Aphelion header structure as the main curation page, with the leftover Click prompt removed.
  • Clear navigation roles: the Admin page now shows Highlights / Options / Public, while the Options page shows Highlights / Admin / Public, so each page points to the other working surfaces without duplicating its own role.
  • Frame consistency: the top banner bottom border was restored, matching the visual boundary used elsewhere in the app.
  • Scrollbar behavior clarified: the layout is intended to keep scrolling inside the main content area between the 36px top and bottom banners, rather than letting page scrollbars overlay the banners themselves.

This leaves Aphelion in a good place to pause: the curation direction is established, the admin/options shell is calmer, and the next pass can move back into card workflow details rather than layout repair.
